name: Scrobble
author: Darryl G. Wright
description: Publish the currently playing track to your Nostr status (NIP-38) and to ListenBrainz.

barWidget.description: Now playing, published to Nostr and ListenBrainz. Hover for your identity and the current track.

schema.label: Publishing enabled
schema.description: Master switch. Turning this off clears your Nostr status.

schema.label: Publish to Nostr
schema.description: Set a NIP-38 music status (kind 30315) on your Nostr profile.

schema.label: Publish to ListenBrainz
schema.description: Send a now-playing, then a listen once the track has played long enough.

schema.label: Only this player
schema.description: Match part of a player's name, such as spotify or chromium. Leave empty to follow whatever is playing.

schema.label: Settle delay (seconds)
schema.description: How long a track must play before it is published, so skipping through an album does not spam the relays.
